course_summary:
ISEN 663 | Engineering Management Control Systems (MCS) | 3 Fall 2025
Instructor: Michael Graul, PhD PE | mgraul@tamu.edu
Meets: M 5:45-8:15p (section 600); lecture videos available Monday night after 8:30p (section 700) | ZACH 440 (section 600); YuJa channel, Canvas Zoom Pro 1.3 tab (section 700)
Grading: Quizzes [20%], Homework [20%], Midterm Exam [30%], Project Work [30%] — A: [90,100] B: [80-90) C: [70,80) D: [60,70) F: [0,60)
Topics: Conant-Ashby theorem, "Every good regulator of a system is a model of the system that it regulates.", managerial cybernetics, SE architectures, SE archetypes, IDEF0 modeling, VSM introduction, VSM analysis, VSM design, VSM development, variety engineering, balanced scorecard, Levers of Control (LOC), financial responsibility centers, Pre-action control, STS (Socio-Technical Systems), HRO (Highly Reliable ORGs), NextGEN ORG Design, ORG SYS analysis, ORG SYS design, reference models (REFMODs), production/productive systems, engineered integration, human-centric organizations, constituencies, value propositions, supporting functions, ST primer, nature of controls, Organization Fit, Organization Function, Organization Form, structures, Models, Strategy maps, objects of control, Costs of controls, Financial controls, budget controls, planning, leadership, Cases
